男生和女生,很高兴认识你,我是Dora,欢迎来到我的课堂请准备好你的教材和本课时的课堂任务单今天我们将学习新的MassMediaMassMedia是什么?想一想第二,每当你想看你最喜欢的节目或得到最新的新闻消息,你会去哪里?你比较可能会转到你的手机、新闻,或者转到你的电视或电脑我们得到的新闻和新闻来源是MassMedia例如,新闻,媒体,电视,电视和网络MassMedia改变了在网络,电视和网络变化之前,人们如何得到新闻消息?对,从新闻课堂说,你如何得到新闻消息?新闻的不同部分是什么?看看这个这是新闻的第一章我们称之为前章头版前章是关于重要或有趣的新闻,吸引最多的观众这是什么?对,是新闻的名字上海学生周末周末是什么意思?猜猜吧对,是一本新闻或新闻一周或每周发布的新闻发布新闻的意思是准备和印刷出版,发行如果每天发布新闻,我们可以称之为上海学生周末我们如何称之为这些?我们称之为头版头版是大标题的新闻文章看看这个绿色盒子我们称之为我们称之为我们在第六年学会了这个词我们可以在超市找到不同的部分例如,我们可以在果果部分买苹果但是,这是什么?这是一个新闻的部分这是一个新闻的部分它专注于一个题目版面你能告诉我这个文章的部分吗?对,是学校这篇文章主要关于什么?可能是学校生活你能把其他可能的部分称为新闻文章吗?你能尝试一下吗?我们有部分像是新闻、运动和健康好,我们也有部分像是宣传、娱乐、商业、时尚、人类等等谁决定哪些文章可以放在新闻上?编辑编辑我们有首席编辑,是整个文章的执行人我们也有执行人执行不同的部分他们决定了文章的内容,也有时写文章你有学校的新闻文章吗?你认为学校的新闻文章应该有什么?可能你读完文章后会有很多东西要分享读完文章前,请看看照片、名字和介绍想想三个问题学生在照片中做什么?你认为读完文章后会有什么?为什么他们的手抬起来?梅森,他们在照片中做什么?他们在举办会议为什么举办会议?他们想发布新闻什么样的新闻?我认为是学校的新闻什么是新闻?怎么看来?看来是报道对,看来是举办会议的报道为什么他们的手抬起来?他们的手抬起来回答问题吗?不,可能他们把手抬起来示意他们同意看来他们在选择某些东西可能他们在选择某些东西在选择某些东西表示你想选择把手抬起来,说出你的选择,说出你的选择等等投票表决你曾经投票给某些人吗?例如,我们的教授请我们选择Monitor而我选择Alice选择意味着选择通过投票选举,推选学生在照片中想选择某些人因此,他们把手抬起来投票给他或她另一个问题你能否告诉我,谁写的这份报告?Arthur写的谁写的这份报告?可能是教授Arthur写的这份报告是关于教授的会议假设你是教授假设你是教授你对这份报告有什么想知道的?假设我是教授我对这份会议有什么想知道的?例如,他们在会议中做了什么?他们决定了什么?他们会做什么?你呢,Kate?我想知道这份报告的名字这份报告的名字是什么?他们会有什么项目?我真的想知道这份报告是免费的吗?你想知道这份报告是免费的吗?我也想知道我对学生们也感兴趣他们会参加会议吗?他们会参加会议吗?谁会执行这份报告的?Mason,你对这份报告有什么想知道的?假设我是教授我想知道这份报告是免费的吗?很好他们应该与教授提供了他们需要的帮助现在,请打开你的书籍转到55号让我们读一下报告在读中,想想教授对这份报告的真实知识他能否得到我们列出的信息?请阅读会议报告并思考校长是否能够获得我们所列出的这些信息时间到了请阅读会议领导人是否认识这份报告?你又怎样能处理所有的行为?你真的太幸运了我真的太幸运了我知道,我真的太幸运了我真的太幸运了有时候我们选择喝一杯水因为喝了会胖所以能够尽量在心中川婴生可能会感到灼热但是我真的会尽量待在心中然后可以回家还有小鱼也应该聆听我也会,可以在太阳过去What did they do first at the meeting?They elected the chief editor.We know that editors are responsible for different sections, remember?What is a chief editor in charge of?A chief editor is in charge of the whole newspaper.Great!Who did they elect to be the chief editor?Joyce, right?Who did they elect to be the secretary?ArthurWhat does a secretary do at the meeting?He takes notes.What about the other three?Pancy, Millie and Tony are editors.Now we know what each of the students is responsible for.I have some more questions for you to discuss.Please read this part again and think about these questions.Have you got the answers?How many times did they vote?TwiceWhat did they elect by voting?Kate, would you like to have a try?They elected the chief editor and the secretary.What did they elect by voting?Did they elect editors?They didn't elect editors.Joyce said that the other three would be editors of the paper.So it was Joyce's decision, right?Why were Joyce and Arthur elected to be the chief editor and the secretary?Because they had experience.What experience do they have?What did they do last year?From the report, we know that Joyce was an editor of a class newspaper last year.Arthur was secretary of the reading club last year.Can you guess the meaning of experience?Experience means skill or knowledge gained from doing something.They have experience because they did the similar job last year.Here, experience means 经验,实践Please read after me.ExperienceGood.The first part of the meeting is about making decisions.But still, there are many things they haven't decided yet.Suppose you are Arthur.Can you list the questions the students will discuss at the next meeting?Please read from line 12 to line 29 and write down the questions on your worksheet.Please read from line 12 to line 29.Okay.What are your questions, Nathan?I can find the three questions in paragraph 6.How often should we publish the paper?Should it be free to readers or should they pay for it?What does it refer to?It refers to the newspaper.What does the word they refer to?They refer to the readers.The word they refers to the readers.What is the third question?The last question is what should we call it?It refers to the new newspaper.Good job, Nathan.Thank you very much.Any more questions?Please read from line 16 to line 18 again.The first sentence says, Then we made a list of some other things we should discuss.What does the word other imply?It suggests they have something else to discuss.Let's go back to read line 14 and line 15 again.Joyce asked them to talk something over among themselves and said they would decide at the next meeting.What is that?What will they discuss and decide at the next meeting?Right.It is the question Pency asked.Which section will we have?So they have four questions to discuss at the next meeting.Let's summarize.Can you use a noun phrase to summarize each of the questions they will discuss?For example, the first one, they will discuss the frequency of publishing the newspaper.What else will they discuss?They will discuss the price of the newspaper, the name of the newspaper, and the sections of the newspaper.Good job.Let's move on.Please read from line 12 to line 29 again and find answers to these two questions.Which question did they think about for a short time during the meeting?In line 19, we can find a sentence, We considered the last question briefly.To consider means to think about something carefully.Briefly means for a short time.What is the question they considered briefly?Is the question clear enough?Here, it refers to the new newspaper.The better answer is, what should they call the newspaper?Question 2.What are the things they will decide at the next meeting?They listed many things to discuss at the next meeting.Among them, they have two important things to decide.Can you find them in paragraph 5 and the last paragraph?Yes, they will decide the sections and the name of the newspaper.Other's report tells us a lot about the meeting.It is very detailed.There is another kind of meeting record called minutes.Minutes only include main ideas and important information.Suppose you are author, what will you choose to write in the minutes?What information should the minutes include?Kate, do you have any ideas?I think it should include some basic information, such as the date, the place and the students who attended the meeting.We should know when, where and who, not only who attended the meeting, but also who took charge of the meeting, I mean the chairman or chairwoman, and who took notes, the secretary.Since the passage doesn't mention the date and the place, let's suppose the meeting was held in the club meeting room on April 4.What information will you include, Nathan?I think it is important to know what they did and what they decided at the meeting.Good point.What they did at the meeting is the procedure.Topics and decisions are the focus of the meeting.Also, we should list things we will discuss at the next meeting.Do you think so?If the next meeting has been arranged, what else will you write?Yes, the arrangements of the next meeting.Boys and girls, can you help Arthur complete the minutes?This is part of your homework.You also need to finish the tasks listed on the homework sheet.今天的作業除了完成這份會議教之外,還需要完成這些列在作業單上的內容。That is all for today.See you next time.Thank
